name: producer-starting-contract

payload.valueRule: One or more uppercase ASCII words separated by exactly one ordinary space; no leading or trailing space.

authority: This is a provisional team contract, not a fixed user requirement. A change requires explicit agreement of the actual concerned teammates on one exact shared revision; preserve a short change record.
completion: An initial payload is a draft. Remain responsible for justified in-scope revisions until independent validation accepts the agreed final contract.
